result.instructions: Tools for Capsule CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which opportunities close this month, and what is their total value?"; "Find the party for Acme Ltd and show me their latest notes."; "List my open tasks due this week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Capsule CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run capsule_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run capsule_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run capsule_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. capsule_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: capsule_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Show the Capsule user the API token belongs to (name, email, team). Good first call to check the connection. Capsule API: GET /users/current.

tools.name: capsule_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users on the Capsule account (owners of parties, opportunities and tasks). Capsule API: GET /users.

tools.name: capsule_list_parties
tools.title: List parties
tools.description: List parties: people and organisations (contacts and companies) on the account. Use `since` to fetch only recent changes. Capsule API: GET /parties.

since.description: Only records changed after this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: capsule_search_parties
tools.title: Search parties
tools.description: Search people and organisations by a name, email, phone number or postcode, as the global Capsule search does. Capsule API: GET /parties/search.

tools.name: capsule_get_party
tools.title: Get a party
tools.description: Show one party (person or organisation) by id, with its contact details, owner and tags. Capsule API: GET /parties/{partyId}.

partyId.description: The party id (from capsule_list_parties or capsule_search_parties).

tools.name: capsule_list_party_notes
tools.title: List notes for a party
tools.description: List notes, emails and completed tasks recorded against one party, newest first. Capsule API: GET /parties/{partyId}/entries.

tools.name: capsule_list_opportunities
tools.title: List opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities (deals) with their value, expected close date, probability and milestone. Capsule API: GET /opportunities.

since.description: Only records changed after this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: capsule_search_opportunities
tools.title: Search opportunities
tools.description: Search opportunities by name or other text, as the global Capsule search does. Capsule API: GET /opportunities/search.

tools.name: capsule_get_opportunity
tools.title: Get an opportunity
tools.description: Show one opportunity by id, with its party, milestone, value and owner. Capsule API: GET /opportunities/{opportunityId}.

tools.name: capsule_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines defined on the account. Capsule API: GET /pipelines.

tools.name: capsule_list_milestones
tools.title: List milestones of a pipeline
tools.description: List the stages (milestones) of one pipeline, in order. Capsule API: GET /pipelines/{pipelineId}/milestones.

tools.name: capsule_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (called kases in the API) on the account. Capsule API: GET /kases.

tools.name: capsule_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks. By default only open tasks are returned; pass `status` to include completed or pending ones. Capsule API: GET /tasks.

status.description: Task states to include. Default: open only.

tools.name: capsule_create_party
tools.title: Create a party
tools.description: Create a person or an organisation. For a person, give firstName and lastName; for an organisation, give name. Capsule API: POST /parties.

type.description: Whether the new party is a person or an organisation.

organisationId.description: Id of the organisation a new person belongs to.

tools.name: capsule_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity for an existing party. Give a currency with an amount. Capsule API: POST /opportunities.

partyId.description: Id of the party (customer) the opportunity belongs to.

milestoneId.description: Id of the pipeline stage (from capsule_list_milestones).

tools.name: capsule_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create an open task with a due date on a party, an opportunity or a project. Give at least one of partyId, opportunityId or projectId. Capsule API: POST /tasks.

description.description: Short task title, e.g. 'Send quarterly invoice'.

tools.name: capsule_add_party_note
tools.title: Add a note to a party
tools.description: Add a plain-text note to a party's timeline. Notes are only created, never edited or deleted here. Capsule API: POST /entries.

partyId.description: The party the note belongs to.

content.description: Note text. Line breaks are kept.

annotations.title: Add a note to a party

prompts.name: review_open_deals_and_their_stages

prompts.description: List opportunities with value, expected close date and probability. Read the stages of a pipeline in order.

prompts.name: find_tasks_and_projects

prompts.description: List tasks, which are open by default. Pass a status to include completed or pending tasks. List the projects of the account.

prompts.name: create_a_party_with_a_deal_and_a_task
prompts.title: Create a party with a deal and a task
prompts.description: Create a person or an organisation. Then create an opportunity for that party and a task on the opportunity.

prompts.name: add_a_note_to_a_party
prompts.title: Add a note to a party
prompts.description: Add a plain-text note to the timeline of a party. Notes are only created, never edited or deleted here.
